title: Change Protocol
intro: {{device}} normally has this set automatically from what the device announces. Use this only when a terminal has just been switched between cloud and local server modes.
pin_notice: Saving pins this value: the server stops changing it automatically until the device itself sends evidence it speaks a different protocol (a fresh handshake, an attendance push, or a registration call), at which point the pin is cleared and the correction is recorded in the audit log — never silent.
